phase: Phase 26: Edge Acoustic Intelligence & Mesh Airtime Congestion Governance

stories.title: Pure KMP Spectral Subtraction Speech Enhancer & Wind Noise Suppressor
stories.description: Implement SpectralNoiseModels.kt and SpectralNoiseSuppressor.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/audio/. Provides real-time frequency-domain noise suppression using pure KMP spectral subtraction with recursive minimum statistics noise floor tracking, Wiener filter gain estimation, over-subtraction factor alpha, and spectral floor beta to eliminate musical noise. Attenuates dynamic non-stationary helmet wind turbulence (>80 km/h) and exhaust rumble with zero Java, C, or external ML dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or external ML dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
Defines NoiseSuppressionMode, SpectralNoiseProfile, NoiseEstimationStats, and SpectralFrameDiagnostics data models
Implements pure Kotlin STFT/filterbank framing (256/512-point window) with Hanning analysis/synthesis and overlap-add reconstruction
Dynamic noise floor tracking adapts to changing aerodynamic speed and environment without speech distortion
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Hands-Free Acoustic Wake Word Engine & Continuous VOX Arbiter
stories.description: Implement WakeWordModels.kt and AcousticWakeWordEngine.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/audio/. Provides low-latency, zero-cloud offline acoustic keyword spotting for 'Hey Alpha' and 'Emergency SOS' using energy envelope trajectory and phonetic formant band scoring, enabling hands-free PTT trigger and speech hold-tail state management during high-speed riding.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP keyword spotting engine with zero cloud or third-party ML runtime dependencies
Supports 'Hey Alpha' (hands-free PTT) and 'Emergency SOS' (priority distress broadcast) wake triggers
Configurable confidence threshold, false-trigger rejection under high wind noise, and refractory cooldown periods
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Real-Time Channel Airtime Congestion Governor & Adaptive FEC Shaper
stories.description: Implement CongestionModels.kt and AirtimeCongestionGovernor.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/qos/. Measures local channel busy ratio (CBR) and transmission collision estimates, dynamically throttling non-voice telemetry queues (GPS beacons, biometric packets, thumbnail chunks) and adjusting audio Forward Error Correction (FEC) redundancy to maintain <= 80ms voice latency under heavy mesh airtime contention.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP channel busy ratio (CBR) tracking and congestion tier classification (UNCONGESTED, MODERATE, HIGH, CRITICAL)
Dynamic duty-cycle throttling applied to bulk and non-critical control traffic during speech bursts
Adaptive audio packet repetition / FEC adjustment based on observed collision rates
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: 32-Node Alpine Blizzard Acoustic & RF Contention Benchmark & Archify Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement AlpineBlizzardSimulationHarness.kt simulating a 32-node alpine blizzard convoy under extreme wind noise (+15 dB noise-to-signal ratio), hands-free wake word triggering, and heavy RF airtime contention. Validates audio intelligibility, zero voice frame loss, and updates Archify architecture showcase with 9/9 verification pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 32 nodes in blizzard conditions with severe wind turbulence and acoustic noise
Validates spectral subtraction noise suppression boosting effective SNR by >= 12 dB
Validates hands-free wake word detection and congestion governor airtime throttling
Archify architecture specification and HTML showcase updated with 9/9 verification pass
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets
